🌡️ MARKET ATMOSPHERE

1. Global Risk Regime?
RISK-OFF. Breadth: 2/11 sectors positive, narrow/weak; VXX (1W: +16.96% | 1M: +24.45%) ABOVE TREND and the SPY/TLT ratio (1W: -1.94% | 1M: -4.47%) BELOW TREND confirm rising fear and bonds outperforming stocks. HYG/LQD is a counter-signal, rising (1W: +0.25% | 1M: +0.34%) ABOVE TREND, which indicates credit stress easing.

2. Primary Risk Drivers?
Fear is increasing: VXX (1W: +16.96% | 1M: +24.45%) ABOVE TREND; stocks are lagging bonds: SPY/TLT (1W: -1.94% | 1M: -4.47%) BELOW TREND. HYG/LQD (1W: +0.25% | 1M: +0.34%) ABOVE TREND is easing, not worsening, credit stress.

3. Financial Conditions Signal?
Dollar strength is firming (1W: +0.65% | 1M: +2.21%) ABOVE TREND; the yield-curve indicator is falling (1W: -1.71% | 1M: -0.64%) BELOW TREND. Duration preference is also falling (1W: -1.12% | 1M: -0.82%) BELOW TREND.

📈 EQUITIES & FLOWS

4. Sector Leadership?
Staples are the clearest sector strength: XLP (1W: +0.47% | 1M: +4.87%) ABOVE TREND; Energy ETF XLE (1W: +1.85% | 1M: -6.55%) is in RECOVERY. Tech is weak: XLK (1W: -3.34% | 1M: -12.21%) BELOW TREND; with breadth at 2/11, style mixed / no clear leadership.

5. US vs Global?
US equities are weak: SPY (1W: -2.33% | 1M: -4.44%) BELOW TREND. Emerging markets lag: EEM (1W: -3.80% | 1M: -7.96%) BELOW TREND, while India holds up: INDA (1W: +0.35% | 1M: +9.49%) ABOVE TREND.

6. Speculative Appetite?
Speculation is weakening: ARKK (1W: -8.12% | 1M: -13.94%) BELOW TREND and IBIT (1W: -13.29% | 1M: -21.94%) BELOW TREND. Small caps also retreat: IWM (1W: -4.11% | 1M: -0.82%) BELOW TREND.

🛢️ REAL ECONOMY

7. Commodities Theme?
Industrial metals are under pressure: CPER (1W: -4.64% | 1M: -9.05%) BELOW TREND. Gold is also weak: GLD (1W: -4.57% | 1M: -7.17%) BELOW TREND.

8. Energy Trend?
Energy is bouncing short term but remains weak on the month: XLE (1W: +1.85% | 1M: -6.55%) in RECOVERY; Brent ETF BNO (1W: +1.03% | 1M: -12.16%) in RECOVERY. Natural gas remains BELOW TREND: UNG (1W: -3.65% | 1M: -4.02%).

🧭 STRATEGY

9. Trend Confirmation?
CONFIRMED weakness: SPY (1W: -2.33% | 1M: -4.44%) and XLK (1W: -3.34% | 1M: -12.21%) are both BELOW TREND; VXX (1W: +16.96% | 1M: +24.45%) is ABOVE TREND. DIVERGENCE: TLT (1W: -1.64% | 1M: +0.53%) is in CORRECTION, while HYG/LQD is rising (1W: +0.25% | 1M: +0.34%) ABOVE TREND.

10. Portfolio Direction?
Favor the relative resilience of XLP (1W: +0.47% | 1M: +4.87%) ABOVE TREND; reduce exposure to persistent weakness in XLK (1W: -3.34% | 1M: -12.21%) BELOW TREND and ARKK (1W: -8.12% | 1M: -13.94%) BELOW TREND. Keep risk measured given narrow breadth and rising volatility.

🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

11. Sectors to Watch?
BULLISH: If breadth improves from 2/11 and staples hold up, monitor XLP (1W: +0.47% | 1M: +4.87%) ABOVE TREND.
BEARISH: If selling broadens, watch XLK (1W: -3.34% | 1M: -12.21%) BELOW TREND for continued weakness.

12. Commodities to Watch?
BULLISH: If the short-term energy rebound persists, monitor XLE (1W: +1.85% | 1M: -6.55%) in RECOVERY.
BEARISH: If industrial demand signals weaken further, watch CPER (1W: -4.64% | 1M: -9.05%) BELOW TREND.

13. Key Levels?
Monitor HYG/LQD at 0.7459, rising (1W: +0.25% | 1M: +0.34%) ABOVE TREND; SPY/TLT at 9.2073, falling (1W: -1.94% | 1M: -4.47%) BELOW TREND; and Tech/Financials at 2.8607, falling (1W: -3.81% | 1M: -14.04%) BELOW TREND.

📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

RISK-OFF, with Breadth: 2/11 sectors positive, indicating narrow/weak participation. Staples ETF XLP (1W: +0.47% | 1M: +4.87%) ABOVE TREND and India ETF INDA (1W: +0.35% | 1M: +9.49%) ABOVE TREND show relative strength. Monitor whether rising fear in VXX (1W: +16.96% | 1M: +24.45%) ABOVE TREND overwhelms the easing signal from HYG/LQD (1W: +0.25% | 1M: +0.34%) ABOVE TREND.
